text: All sensitive business and property-related information—including details of property specifications, business operations, corporate agreements, negotiations, tenant data, and commercial plans—must be protected and accessed only by authorized personnel to prevent unauthorized exposure and ensure confidentiality.

All internal personnel information, including work schedules, role changes, contact details, and personal data, must be kept confidential and must not be disclosed to unauthorized individuals or external parties to prevent exposure of sensitive employee information.

All employees and contractors must strictly protect the confidentiality of sensitive corporate information, including but not limited to strategic plans, internal projects, personnel data, contact details, and any proprietary business information. Unauthorized disclosure or sharing of such information is strictly prohibited to safeguard the company's competitive position and operational integrity.

All employees and contractors must avoid disclosing any sensitive corporate information, including organizational structure, personnel details, internal communications, project plans, business locations, and proprietary data, both internally and externally, to protect the company's confidentiality and security.
Staff must not disclose any personal or direct contact information, including phone numbers, fax numbers, or email addresses, in public or unsecured communications.
Do not share or disclose information about living locations, specific apartments, or detailed property specifications to protect privacy and prevent sensitive information exposure.
All movement details, travel plans, exact locations, times, and related personal or business information must be kept confidential and not disclosed to unauthorized parties.
All subscription details and related information must be kept confidential and must not be disclosed to unauthorized individuals or systems to prevent exposure of sensitive data.
